name: configurable_repeated_holdout_visualization
scope: Read-only post-training visualization of native repeated-holdout aggregation outputs

figures.figure1: Multiple metric panels in one PDF; each panel compares selected models across repeats
figures.figure2: One mean ROC panel per selected model using per-repeat interpolation and macro-averaging
figures.figure3: One ROC panel per selected model for the deterministic best observed repeat
figures.figure4: One RA/ILD probability boxplot panel per selected model using the same best repeat as Figure 3

hotfix.resolution: Use runtime-compatible trapezoid integration with numpy.trapezoid and legacy fallback
